articles.headline: Why Bill Parcells considers Jacoby Brissett to be like a son
articles.description: Bill Parcells has been a mentor to Jacoby Brissett since high school, guiding him through football and life decisions.
articles.headlineJa: ビル・パーセルズがジャコビー・ブリスエットを実の息子のように思う理由
articles.descriptionJa: ビル・パーセルズは20年近くにわたりジャコビー・ブリスエットのメンターを務め、フットボールのプレーから人生の決断に至るまで彼を導いてきた。
articles.body:
TEMPE, Ariz. -- Twice a year since high school, Jacoby Brissett walked into Duffy's Sports Grill in Jupiter, Florida, and headed to the round booth in the corner for a lunchtime "Board of Directors" meeting.

Except Brissett wasn't on the board of any organization, charity or company. And this certainly wasn't a conference room. His meetings were just three guys around a table talking about life and football -- which, for them, is largely one and the same.

If there's a chairman of this mythical board, it's Pro Football Hall of Fame coach Bill Parcells, who named this biannual lunch that includes Brissett and his longtime friend and adviser Abe Elam.

"We just sit and start talking," Brissett told ESPN.

The conversation can range from Brissett starting at quarterback for the Arizona Cardinals to Parcells' old team, the New York Giants, with whom he won two Super Bowls. The teams converge Sunday when the Giants host the Cardinals (1 p.m. ET, CBS).

Parcells, who turned 85 in late August, spends his summers in upstate New York and winters on the east coast of Florida. He and Brissett will talk after Sunday's game just as they have after each of the first three games of the season.

They'll talk football, but the relationship transcends sports. Parcells is one of the most important figures in the life of Brissett, 33. Their friendship spans nearly 20 years, back to when Parcells befriended Brissett's high school coach and started hanging around practices at William T. Dwyer High School in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. He became a mentor to Brissett, guiding him in finances, professionalism and, of course, football.

In return, Parcells gained a willing pupil who parlayed his guidance into an 11-year NFL career. Brissett may not be the most talented QB Parcells has coached -- he's on his sixth team -- but lasting that long in the league is a testament to the intangibles that drew Parcells into the relationship.

"I had three daughters; he's like a son," Parcells told ESPN. "That really is what the relationship is, in the respect that I look at it. And my job is just to try to guide and be direct as I can without being a nuisance and without badgering him and without doing anything or telling him, 'This is what you need to do. This is how you need to try to go forward in this business.'

"And he's a very good listener, and he's done everything right in his career in terms of trying to prepare, getting ready physically, getting ready mentally. And he's been very good with his finances. He's a very good listener about that. And I'm just proud of him. I love him."

Why Brissett believes he wouldn't be in the NFL if not for Parcells

Football wasn't Brissett's priority in high school. Far from it. In his mind, he was destined to play basketball. So, when Brissett met Parcells early in his high school career, Brissett didn't really know this older man coming to watch him practice.

"The funny thing is, I hated football," Brissett said.

articles.body:
Manchester City striker Erling Haaland favors a move to Spain over Arsenal, while Barcelona retain interest in Club Brugge striker Nicolo Tresoldi. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Trending rumors

- Manchester City striker Erling Haaland favors a move to Spain over Arsenal, despite the Gunners having the financial muscle to pursue him, reports TEAMtalk. After news of City's financial charges that could result in the club's relegation, Haaland's camp has identified 2027 as a potential departure date from the Etihad for the Norway striker, though his contract runs to 2034. And Barcelona will be looking to put themselves in pole position for his signature alongside Real Madrid if he does become available.

- Barcelona retain interest in Club Brugge striker Nicolò Tresoldi after tracking him during the summer, according to Sport. The Catalan giants ultimately opted to sign Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal, but could revisit a move for the 22-year-old Germany Under-21 international in a future transfer window.

Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi is keen on a reunion with the 29-year-old Japan international, who played under him at Brighton, but Mitoma is also attracting interest from Liverpool as his contract approaches its final 18 months.

- Juventus are eyeing Brentford right back Michael Kayode as part of their plans to reinforce their defense, as per Gazzetta dello Sport. The Bianconeri have kept an eye on their former youth player for several seasons when he moved to Gozzano and Fiorentina, before starring at Brentford, while Fiorentina midfielder Cher Ndour and Borussia Dortmund youngster Samuele Inácio are also under consideration.

- Liverpool winger Federico Chiesa is open to a return to Serie A ahead of the January transfer window, according to Calciomercato. Internazionale, Atalanta and Lazio are all monitoring the Italy international, who is seeking regular first-team football after struggling for opportunities at Anfield.

articles.headline: All-time rosters for 23 teams with multiple Super Bowls
articles.description: This was no small task, but 13 players ended up making more than one all-time SB roster.
articles.headlineJa: スーパーボウルで複数回の優勝を果たした23チームの歴代ベストメンバー
articles.descriptionJa: 決して簡単な作業ではなかったが、最終的に13人の選手が複数のチームの歴代スーパーボウル・ロースターに選出された。
articles.body:
ESPN will televise the Super Bowl for the first time in February 2027. We will count down to the big game with Super Bowl-centric stories every month.

Picking an all-time Super Bowl team for Super Bowls I-XL would be a difficult task, matching up players from different eras, under different rules and different schematics, but a lot of the names would be familiar and mostly Hall of Fame worthy.

Picking an all-time Super Bowl team for each individual franchise is a little trickier.

Twenty-three teams have played in multiple Super Bowls. Our goal was to come up with an all-time roster for each of those franchises, leaning toward the success those players had in the Super Bowls in which they played, regardless of the success of their overall career or in that particular season(s).

As an example, Larry Brown was one of the Dallas Cowboys' choices at cornerback, not Hall of Famer Deion Sanders.

Why? Brown intercepted two passes in Super Bowl XXX and was named the game's Most Valuable Player.

Across all of the 23 rosters, 13 players were selected for two franchises' all-time Super Bowl teams, including four former New England Patriots: QB Tom Brady (Buccaneers), K Adam Vinatieri (Colts), G Joe Thuney (Chiefs) and TE Rob Gronkowski (Buccaneers).

Here are the selections made by our NFL Nation reporters:

The Super Bowl LI team accounts for most of the selections given how potent the Falcons were on offense in that game despite the historic blowing of that 28-3 lead. Matt Ryan was 17-of-23 passing for 284 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions, outplaying his New England Patriots counterpart, Tom Brady. Julio Jones had 87 yards on four catches, Devonta Freeman ran for 75 yards and a touchdown, and Austin Hooper added a touchdown.

Terance Mathis made a case for WR1 with seven catches for 85 yards and a touchdown in Super Bowl XXXIII, but it's hard to pick against Jones. The Super Bowl LI team led the way on defense, too. Grady Jarrett had three sacks, Robert Alford had a pick-six and Deion Jones was a standout. The Falcons had no sacks of John Elway in Super Bowl XXXIII, but Ronnie Bradford did intercept him. articles.headline: Jameis Winston has time to prove he's the New York Giants' starter
articles.description: The Giants might have more patience with Winston than expected as the locker room believes in him implicitly.
articles.headlineJa: ジェイミス・ウィンストン、ニューヨーク・ジャイアンツのスターターであることを証明する時間はまだある
articles.descriptionJa: ロッカールームのメンバーが彼を全面的に信頼しているため、ジャイアンツは予想以上にウィンストンに対して忍耐強く構えるかもしれない。
articles.body:
EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- J.J. McCarthy's first week with the New York Giants is being spent as the third-string quarterback. He arrived after being traded from the Minnesota Vikings for a fifth-round pick and begins behind veteran Jameis Winston and Jake Haener.

Being the third-stringer seems like a temporary thing given his pedigree and the situation. The likelihood is that McCarthy will climb the depth chart once he learns the new offense and gets acclimated to his surroundings. He will either be the backup to Winston or eventually become the team's starter.

It's all dependent on how Winston plays at home on Sunday against the Arizona Cardinals (1 p.m. ET, CBS) and likely next week on the road against the Washington Commanders. He'll have to play better than he did against the Los Angeles Rams or Tennessee Titans. It could be considered a two-week tryout.

Coach John Harbaugh says he is worried about this week and this week only. He even wore a black shirt with big white letters at Wednesday's practice that read "1-0" to accentuate that point.

Winston, a 12-year veteran, knows how this all works. 

"I have to play well regardless. That's it," he said emphatically on Wednesday. "It doesn't matter who's in the building. When you're the quarterback for the New York Football Giants, you have to give your team a chance to win. That's just the business that we're in."

The Giants (2-1) are in a position at the moment where they can be patient. Harbaugh didn't feel the need to talk with Winston this week about trading for McCarthy and the status of his starting job.

Harbaugh did say early in the week that it was going to be "a challenge" for McCarthy to learn the playbook. They'll see how he does and then determine whether he'll jump Haener on the depth chart against Arizona.

But while McCarthy is talented and was selected in the top 10 of the 2024 NFL draft, there is no guarantee he will pick up the offense quickly. And even if he does, who says that McCarthy can play at a level higher than Winston and deserve to be the starter? There are still questions about what he truly is as a quarterback at the NFL level.

One thing is certain: Winston will have to play better than he has in his first two games this season. He has a 22.9 QBR, dead last by a wide margin among the 30 qualifying quarterbacks. Only the Chargers' Justin Herbert (27.4) is below 35.0.

Winston also has a 29.2% off-target percentage on his 49 pass attempts. That is also the worst among all quarterbacks.

The 32-year-old is convinced there is plenty left in his arm.

"Yeah, I know what I'm capable of, but also I know what's required of me," Winston said. "I can make all the throws. I can do anything I put my mind to. I'm blessed to that point. But at the same time, my job is to give the team the best chance to win."

articles.headline: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba off to a historic start, but is it sustainable?
articles.description: Seattle's star receiver is leading the NFL in receiving yards and TDs after signing a big contract extension this summer. But will the Seahawks look to spread the ball more?
articles.headlineJa: シーホークスのWRジャクソン・スミス＝ニジバが歴史的な滑り出しを見せるも、この状態は持続できるのか？
articles.descriptionJa: シアトルのスターレシーバーは、今夏に大型契約を更新した後、NFLのレシービングヤードとタッチダウン数で首位に立っている。しかし、シーホークスはパスをより分散させる方針を取るのだろうか？
articles.body:
RENTON, Wash. -- There is no shortage of ways to contextualize the video game-like numbers that Jaxon Smith-Njigba has put up over the Seahawks' 2-1 start, but we'll begin here: Seattle's All-Pro wideout is only the second player in NFL history with at least 400 receiving yards and six receiving touchdowns over the first three games of a season, according to ESPN Research.

Marvin Harrison Sr. did that with the Indianapolis Colts in 1999. Smith-Njigba joined him last Sunday, when he caught 10 passes for 128 yards and two more scores in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders.

"He is so special," Seahawks safety Julian Love said. "I get home from the game and my wife's like, 'Wow, so they really can't cover Jaxon.' If she's mentioning something about football, that's how you know it's real."

After leading the NFL last season with 1,793 receiving yards, which ranks eighth in NFL history for a season, and winning AP Offensive Player of the Year, the JSN show is off and running again. Heading into the Seahawks' Week 4 game against the Los Angeles Chargers (4:25 p.m. ET, CBS) at Lumen Field, his 405 receiving yards and six receiving scores lead all players, while his 27 catches are tied for tops in the league.

It's too early to start talking seriously about the pace that puts him on (34 touchdowns and almost 2,300 yards), but it is fair to ask whether Smith-Njigba -- in his fourth NFL season and his second catching passes from Sam Darnold -- might have gotten better since he signed a record-setting $168.6 million contract extension this summer.

According to ESPN Research, he's the first player since the Detroit Lions' Calvin Johnson in 2011 with six receiving scores through the first three games of a season. That ties the Seahawks' record that Daryl Turner set over the first three games of 1985.

"It's going to sound silly, but a huge part of it is knowing what we're doing as an offense," Darnold said of Smith-Njigba's start. "Him being locked into our game plan, doing everything that he can throughout the week to prepare himself mentally to hear the call, hear the concept and just going out there and playing fast. Because obviously, when he goes out there and plays fast, he can play ball at that point. He's not running the route like it's supposed to be drawn on paper. He's going out there, finding space and us being on the same page. That's what it's about.

"If they're taking him away, usually that leaves someone else on the field open to go out there and make plays, which I feel like our guys have been doing a good job of."

One notable instance of that came on Seattle's last touchdown against Washington, during which Smith-Njigba drew two defenders at the goal line and created enough traffic to free up Cooper Kupp for a 7-yard score. articles.headline: Evaluating the 3-0 Raiders' strong offensive start
articles.description: Yes, it has been a small sample size. But the head coach has made the Raiders' offense almost unrecognizable.
articles.headlineJa: 3勝0敗でスタートを切ったレイダースの強力な攻撃陣を評価する
articles.descriptionJa: 確かにサンプル数は少ない。しかし、ヘッドコーチはレイダースのオフェンスを、以前とは見分けがつかないほどに変貌させた。
articles.body:
HENDERSON, Nev. -- Klint Kubiak was one of the best playcallers in this offseason's hiring cycle, and how he has operated the Las Vegas Raiders' offense to start the season is one of the reasons the organization was willing to wait until he helped the Seattle Seahawks win Super Bowl LX before naming him the coach.

The Raiders are in the midst of their first 3-0 start since 2021, the last time they made the postseason, and much of their success is due to Kubiak rejuvenating an offense that was one of the worst in the league in 2025.

Under former coach Pete Carroll and offensive coordinator Chip Kelly, the Raiders averaged 14.2 points per game. That total has jumped to 29.3 points per game -- tied for seventh in the NFL.

Las Vegas beginning the season with a functional offense despite an inconsistent rushing attack and its best playmaker, Brock Bowers, missing two games is a testament to Kubiak's playcalling, his ability to put players in the best positions to be successful and veteran quarterback Kirk Cousins' command of the entire operation.

The Raiders will face their biggest test, the Kansas City Chiefs, at home on Sunday (4:25 p.m. ET, CBS) with a chance to take possession of first place in the AFC West.

"[Kubiak is] aggressive," tight end Ian Thomas told ESPN. "[But] he knows when to pull back, and he'll take chances when he needs to. It's a combination of a little bit of everything."

THREE GAMES IS a small sample size. But differences from this season compared with last, when the Raiders won a total of three games, have been eye-popping.

In 2025, Las Vegas ranked last in total yards per game (245.2), 30th in yards per play (4.4), 31st in offensive efficiency (20.72), 26th in red zone efficiency (50%), 28th in third-down conversion rate (33.8%) and 31st in EPA (minus-124.11).

So far in 2026, Las Vegas is 17th in total yards per game (322.5), 13th in yards per play (5.2), 10th in offensive efficiency (55.58), 17th in red zone efficiency (55.6%), tied for 14th in third-down conversion rate (42.3%) and 14th in EPA (2.78).

The Raiders also have the fifth-best points margin (10) after ranking 30th in that category in 2025.

It shouldn't come as a surprise that Kubiak has come in and improved the offense. He did the same as the offensive coordinator for the Seahawks a year ago. Seattle averaged 28.4 points per game, which ranked second in franchise history.

What's impressive is that Kubiak is having success with a Raiders offense that entered the season with no wide receivers with a 1,000-yard season. He has found multiple ways to win games and put points on the board while utilizing the talent at hand.

The Raiders began the Kubiak era without Bowers, who underwent a meniscus trim procedure ahead of the season opener against the Miami Dolphins. Still, Bowers' two-week absence didn't hinder the offense like his injury absences did last season. Las Vegas defeated Miami and the Los Angeles Chargers by double figures.

articles.headline: Philadelphia Eagles' defense at an inflection point
articles.description: With the next four games against formidable offenses, this stretch will help define whether Philly's defense is for real -- or just real good on paper.
articles.headlineJa: フィラデルフィア・イーグルスの守備、正念場を迎える
articles.descriptionJa: 強力なオフェンスを相手にする次の4試合が、フィリーの守備が真に強力なものなのか、それとも単にデータ上だけで優れているだけなのかを判断する試練となるだろう。
articles.body:
The Eagles' offense was expected to be a work in progress under first-year offensive coordinator Sean Mannion. The thinking went that the defense could serve as the team's bedrock while the other side of the ball found its way.

With the star-studded cast entering Year 3 under one of the greats in defensive coordinator Vic Fangio, this group seemed to have top-five defense written all over it.

It was jarring to watch a projected juggernaut get shredded in real time Monday night, as 38-year-old third-string quarterback Case Keenum completed 71 percent of his passes, threw two touchdowns and ran for another in his first start in 1,009 days, leading the Bears to a 27-7 rout over Philadelphia.

"It just can't happen," Eagles edge Jonathan Greenard said. "We know what the standard is, we know we've got to be better, and we will be better, so I'm not worried."

There is plenty of season left to turn the tide, but with a string of offensive powers coming up, starting with the Los Angeles Rams Sunday (1 pm ET, Fox), this defense finds itself at an early inflection point.

Every unit has a bad day at the office, and Bears coach Ben Johnson has left many a defense soul-searching after an encounter. But the overall numbers through three weeks are less than encouraging.

To start, the Eagles have zero takeaways. It's the first time in franchise history they've been blanked over the first three weeks of the season. They are the only team in the NFL that hasn't generated a turnover.

The Eagles have managed just three sacks, tied for the fourth-lowest output in the league. They are 23rd in defensive efficiency (42.16) and opposing quarterback rating (64.1), 22nd in defensive EPA (-10.30) and 25th in opponent rushing yards per game (127.3).

There are a multitude of reasons for the slow start. At the top of the list is that some of the stars are not playing like stars. Defensive tackle Jalen Carter, fresh off a four-year, $152 million extension, has been wearing a cast on his hand for the last two weeks as he reportedly deals with a hairline fracture in his wrist. Defensive back Cooper DeJean got off to a slow start as he dealt with calf and abdomen injuries. Linebacker Zack Baun, in contrast, started off strong but had a down night against Chicago. He has been sidelined at practice this week with a concussion.

Their big offseason acquisition, Greenard, was on a pitch count in his debut against the Bears after missing extended time with a pec injury.

There has been some turnover at key starting spots, and that has come with an acclimation period. The early returns have been generally positive on corner Riq Woolen, but a breakdown between him and DeJean led to Kalif Raymond being left wide open for a 41-yard touchdown in the second half Monday night.

"We've got to communicate better, make sure everybody gets the call, get everyone on the same page so we don't leave guys running free," DeJean said.

articles.headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
articles.description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグのどの選手が代表ウィーク中に負傷したか？
articles.descriptionJa: 2026-2027クラブシーズン最初の代表ウィークにおける、プレミアリーグのスター選手たちの負傷に関する最新ニュースとアップデート。
articles.body:
Premier League teams will be watching and hoping their star players remain healthy throughout the international break.

However, some have already sustained injuries while playing for their countries. Premier League matches resume on Oct. 10.

ESPN will be tracking the latest injuries and updates for your club's players:

Kai Havertz (Arsenal)

Arsenal's Kai Havertz was forced off in the 30th minute of the game between Netherlands and Germany on September 24th with what was described as a muscle injury.

"Both are currently undergoing an MRI," Jurgen Klopp said on RTL about Havertz and Jamal Musiala. "I hope we get the diagnosis [on Thursday] evening. But of course, this isn't great. I hope it's nothing serious. The lads are probably out for us. But hopefully, they'll be back in action relatively quickly."

On September 25 the German Football Association confirmed the attacker would be leaving Klopp's camp and return to Arsenal after suffering what they describe as a 'muscle strain.'

Brian Brobbey (Sunderland)

The powerful Sunderland attacker was also injured in the same game after picking up what looked like a hamstring injury while running for the ball. He immediately went down and signalled to the sideline.

He left the field of his own accord but did have a heavy limp as he walked down the tunnel.

Netherlands boss Xavi Hernandez said after the game: "Brian is indeed injured."

Brobbey was replaced by Joshua Zirkzee in the Dutch squad.

Zion Suzuki (Aston Villa)

The goalkeeper linked up with the Japan squad but according to reports missed the main group training session on September 22nd, according to local reports. Instead he was put on an individual session for a rib injury.

Suzuki was subsequently left out of Japan's matchday squad entirely for Thursday's 3-1 victory over Uruguay.

Dan Ballard (Sunderland)

The Sunderland defender suffered a reported hamstring injury during Northern Ireland's 1-0 victory over Georgia in the UEFA Nations League.

With the score still 0-0 as the match moved into stoppage time, Ballard chased back as Georgia counter-attacked and pulled up clutching the back of his thigh, unable to finish the match in Tbilisi.

Speaking immediately after Friday's match, manager Michael O'Neill said it was too soon to know the extent of his latest injury but will definitely miss the next three Northern Ireland games.

"We'll scan him tomorrow (Saturday), but he's certainly not going to be available for the next three games."

Alexander Isak (Liverpool)

Alexander Isak is returning to Liverpool after sustaining a "minor injury" on international duty.

The striker scored and played the full 90 minutes in Sweden's 2-1 victory over Romania in the Nations League on Friday.

But Isak, who has made a strong start to the season for Liverpool, will not feature in matches against Poland, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Romania over the remainder of the extended international break.

articles.headline: Sources: Grizzlies waive Jordan Hawkins weeks after Pels trade
articles.description: The Memphis Grizzlies and guard Jordan Hawkins have agreed to part ways via waivers, allowing the 2023 lottery pick to find a new home in free agency, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：グリズリーズ、ペリカンズとのトレードから数週間でジョーダン・ホーキンスをウェイブ
articles.descriptionJa: メンフィス・グリズリーズとガードのジョーダン・ホーキンスがウェイブによる放出に合意し、2023年のロタリーピックである彼がフリーエージェントとして新天地を探すことになったと、ESPNのシャムス・チャラニアに情報筋が伝えた。
articles.body:
The Memphis Grizzlies and guard Jordan Hawkins have agreed to part ways via waivers, allowing the 2023 lottery pick to find a new home in free agency, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

The move comes three weeks after arriving as part of a four-player trade with the New Orleans Pelicans for AJ Johnson and Taj Gibson.

Hawkins, 24, averaged 5.1 points in 51 games last season and struggled to find consistent playing time in New Orleans' crowded backcourt rotation. The former UConn star played just 13.6 minutes per game, a significant decrease from the 2024-25 season, when he played 23.6 minutes per game and averaged 10.8 points per game.

Hawkins, a perimeter shooter, was selected 14th by the Pelicans in the 2023 draft, two years before a regime change that saw Joe Dumars replace David Griffin as basketball operations chief.

articles.body:

The former Manchester United and Borussia Dortmund winger is a free agent, following his exit from Old Trafford at the end of his contract in the summer. The 26-year-old has been linked with a whole host of clubs since, but is yet to make a decision on his future, with nothing advanced on his next club.

- Manchester United and Chelsea are monitoring a deal for Benfica defender Tomás Araújo, according to TEAMTalk. The 24-year-old is claimed to be on the radar of several Premier League clubs, but it's United and Chelsea who are most keen. Araujo, who can play center back and right-back, recently signed a contract extension until 2031, making an exit in January unlikely. However, with a release clause valued at £68 million, clubs could pursue a switch anyway

In defence, Oumar Solet of Udinese is viewed as an option, while RB Leipzig ace David Raum and Crystal Palace star Tyrick Mitchell are also on the Bianconeri's radar. Napoli stalwart Stanislav Lobotka, Manchester City midfielder Mateo Kovacic, and Real Madrid playmaker Brahim Díaz are touted as options for the central ranks. Meanwhile, Crystal Palace forward Jean-Philippe Mateta could be a striker arrival.

That's according to Sport, which reports that the 27-year-old has his sights set on a return to the Champions League after a recent resurgence in his career in the Saudi Pro League. Felix previously spent a year on loan with Barcelona from Atletico Madrid, where he made 44 appearances with 10 goals and six assists. Now back in form, and eyeing a possible free transfer, a return to the Nou Camp is on his mind, though the report claims that he is not viewed as a priority target.

articles.headline: Cucurella: Too soon to judge Mourinho's Madrid amid poor start
articles.description: Marc Cucurella has acknowledged Real Madrid have not started the season as they would have liked under new coach José Mourinho, but he says the team must be judged at the end of the campaign, not now.
articles.headlineJa: ククレリャ：不調なスタートを切った今、モウリーニョ率いるマドリードを判断するには時期尚早
articles.descriptionJa: マルク・ククレリャは、新監督ジョゼ・モウリーニョのもと、レアル・マドリードが望んでいたようなシーズン開幕を迎えられていないことを認めているが、チームの評価は今ではなくシーズン終了時にすべきだと述べている。
articles.body:
Marc Cucurella has acknowledged Real Madrid have not started the season as they would have liked under new coach José Mourinho, but he says the team must be judged at the end of the campaign, not now.

Madrid have suffered two defeats in their opening seven LaLiga games, against Real Betis and Atlético Madrid, leaving them six points behind early leaders Barcelona.

- Torres forced out of Spain squad; Madrid's Espí gets 1st call-up

- De la Fuente says beloved Yamal puts 'magic' at service of Spain

- UEFA receives Madrid dossier on Barça-Negreira case

Cucurella, speaking in a news conference on Friday while on international duty with world champions Spain, said Madrid's new project needs time to take shape.

"It's all a process," Cucurella said. "With the national team, the foundations have been laid over many years -- with the [same] coach, too.

"At Madrid, we have just started with a new manager and it's too soon to speak. Some players only had a week-long preseason before starting.

"The beginning of the season hasn't been what we all hoped for, but it's a process and we will see where we are at the end of the campaign."

Cucurella has picked up where he left off for Spain at the World Cup in the summer, impressing in UEFA Nations League victories over England and Croatia during the last week.

It has led to suggestions the left back -- a €55 million ($62m) summer signing for Madrid from Chelsea -- is better suited to playing for his country than his club.

"It's not even been 10 games yet," Cucurella responded. "There are things to improve [with Madrid], of course. We basically had no preseason, while it's a new club for me.

"I have to adapt to my new teammates and give my best so that the player you see with the national team is the same player with Real Madrid."

Cucurella's form for Chelsea and Spain not only prompted Madrid to sign him in the summer, but also led to him being named among the 30 nominees to win this year's Ballon d'Or.

He is also in the rare position of playing alongside two of the favourites -- Kylian Mbappé with Madrid and Barcelona's Lamine Yamal with Spain -- but would not pick between the two.

"If it was up to me to vote, I would vote for myself," he joked when asked to name his winner.

"But no, two of the candidates to win it are teammates, so who whoever wins it, I will be happy."

Cucurella and Spain are back in action on Saturday when they host Czechia in Oviedo looking to make it three wins from three in the Nations League.

They then close the extended international break with a trip to Croatia on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Miami Heat announce 'A Night in Vice City' theme ahead of GTA VI release
articles.description: With Grand Theft Auto VI's long-awaited release date set for Nov. 19, the Heat are partnering with Rockstar Games to offer a topical lead-up event the night before.
articles.headlineJa: マイアミ・ヒート、『GTA VI』の発売に先駆け「A Night in Vice City」テーマを発表
articles.descriptionJa: 『グランド・セフト・オートVI』の待望の発売日が11月19日に決定したことを受け、ヒートはロックスター・ゲームスと提携し、発売前夜に話題の先行イベントを開催する。
articles.body:
The Miami Heat have been carefully leaning into "Vice City" branding for years now, but 2026 will bring the team's most ambitious effort yet: Nov. 18 will be "A Night in Vice City" at the Kaseya Center.

With Grand Theft Auto VI's long-awaited release date set for Nov. 19, the Heat are partnering with Rockstar Games to offer a topical lead-up event the night before.

Miami is rolling out plenty of offerings for the night. The night will feature a special Vice-themed court and a reimagined edition of the team's popular alternate uniforms, as well as "special game night activities" and "unique game night activations."

According to a news release, the special occasion will "transform the Kaseya Center into Vice City -- showcasing the Miami-inspired setting of Grand Theft Auto VI -- for a first-of-its-kind sports crossover experience."

The Heat kicked off the promotion for the special event Thursday, lighting up "Welcome to Vice City" signage on the roof of the Kaseya Center. The team says it will share more information about "A Night in Vice City" in the coming weeks in coordination with Rockstar Games.

The Heat's game that night against the Milwaukee Bucks will be broadcast on ESPN.

articles.headlineJa: 新加入のカルロス・バレバ、親善試合でマンチェスター・ユナイテッド初出場
articles.descriptionJa: カルロス・バレバは金曜日に行われた非公開の親善試合で、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドとして初めての出場を果たした。
articles.body:
Carlos Baleba played his first minutes in a Manchester United shirt during a behind-closed-doors friendly on Friday.

The 22-year-old signed from Brighton in a £70 million ($93m) deal in August but has not featured in a competitive game due to an ankle injury sustained in preseason with the Seagulls.

He did make the bench for the 1-1 draw at Fulham immediately prior to the international break and has continued working towards full fitness at the club's Carrington training complex.

Baleba took part in a training game against Swiss side Lausanne-Sport alongside fellow first-teamers including Harry Maguire and Matheus Cunha.

Head coach Michael Carrick told club media recently that Baleba was "pushing to get back as quickly as possible" from injury.

articles.headline: Erik ten Hag 'was a piece of crap' with Man United squad - Fred
articles.description: Former Manchester United midfielder Fred has accused ex-boss Erik ten Hag of being a 'piece of crap' when it came to squad management.
articles.headlineJa: フレド、エリック・テン・ハフの選手管理を「最低だった」と批判
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・ユナイテッドの元ミッドフィールダーであるフレドは、元監督のエリック・テン・ハフに対し、選手管理が「最低だった」と非難した。
articles.body:
Former Manchester United midfielder Fred has accused ex-boss Erik ten Hag of being a "piece of crap" when it came to squad management.

The Brazilian spent five years at United, winning the League Cup and reaching the FA Cup final in the 2022-23 season.

Ten Hag came to United with a big reputation, having managed Ajax for four seasons and taking them to the Champions League semifinals but, while he did win the FA Cup and League Cup in his two-and-a-half years in Manchester, things did not quite go as planned with regards to success in the Premier League.

And Fred, who left the club to join Turkish side Fenerbahce during Ten Hag's tenure ahead of the 2023-24 season, gave a damning review of his time under the Dutchman.

"Ten Hag was tactically very good, but with the group he was a piece of crap," he said on the "Charla Podcast."

"He argued with everyone. He argued with me, with Cristiano [Ronaldo], with Casemiro, with Rashford ... He wouldn't put me in to play, sometimes it got stressful.

"[With Ten Hag] Only his Dutch players played. A clique-ridden coach. But, tactically, one of the best I've ever worked with.

- Sir Alex Ferguson on David Beckham's Preston loan: 'He thought I wanted him gone but that's not true'

- Sir Alex Ferguson was 'terrified' about Old Trafford return after brain surgery

- Rasmus Højlund hits 'Siuuu' against Portugal: 'Cristiano Ronaldo will never be forgotten'

"He wanted the team to run, but Cristiano [was already] older. He took Cristiano out [of the starting lineup], and then there was a falling out."

Ronaldo left the club at the end of the 2022 season after he found himself no longer in the starting lineup.

Ten Hag was sacked in October 2024, with United 14th after seven matches -- their worst start since the 1989-90 season.

Fred also lifted the lid on other United managers he experienced, including Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, the 1999 treble winner who took the helm at the club in December 2018 after Jose Mourinho was sacked.

The 33-year-old, who has 32 Brazil caps, gave his assessment of both of those managers, who he had much more positive things to say about.

"Solskjaer was good with the group, but he was helped [in training] by the assistants. He united the group," Fred added.

"Mourinho's a great bloke, he is funny. I've just been with him at Fenerbahçe; he brought me to United.

"Before [Carlo] Ancelotti came along, his name was being mentioned for the national team [Brazil].

"So I'd show him the rumours and he'd say: 'F--- off, mate. I'm not going anywhere. I'm going to manage my club here.' A really decent bloke."

articles.headline: Raphinha set to be fit for Barcelona clashes with PSG and Real Madrid - source
articles.description: Raphinha will be fit for Barcelona's double header against Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid later this month after tests revealed no major injury to his right thigh on Friday, a source told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: ラフィーニャ、バルセロナのPSG戦およびレアル・マドリード戦に向けて復帰の見込み ― 関係者
articles.descriptionJa: 金曜日に行われた検査で右太ももに大きな怪我は見られなかったため、ラフィーニャは今月後半のパリ・サンジェルマンおよびレアル・マドリードとの連戦に向けて復帰できる見込みだと、関係者がESPNに語った。
articles.body:
Raphinha will be fit for Barcelona's double header against Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid later this month after tests revealed no major injury to his right thigh on Friday, a source told ESPN.

Raphinha, 29, was taken off at half time of Brazil's 4-2 win over Australia on Tuesday after feeling some discomfort in his thigh.

He was subsequently removed from the Brazil squad for Saturday's game against India and flew back to Barcelona, were he underwent tests on Friday.

A club source told ESPN those tests had confirmed Brazil's initial assessment, that Raphinha "has edema in the thigh rather than an injury."

The news comes as a major relief to Barça after alarm bells were set ringing on Tuesday when Raphinha was taken off.

The forward missed 25 games for club and country last season due to a hamstring problem in the same thigh and there were fears he had suffered a relapse.

Despite the good news, sources say Barça will manage the player's minutes with caution ahead of some massive games in October.

Barça, who have won all eight of their matches this season, return to action after the international break on Oct. 10 against Getafe.

- UEFA receives Real Madrid dossier on Barcelona-Negreira case

- Clásico match ball for Barcelona vs. Real Madrid LaLiga clashes unveiled

- Transfer rumors, news: Several Premier League clubs eye Koundé move

In theory, Raphinha could feature in that game, but coach Hansi Flick will make a decision on his participation in the days before the fixture.

Barça then travel to Galatasaray and Real Betis before a huge week which sees them face PSG in the Champions League on Oct. 20 and Madrid in LaLiga on Oct. 25.

Raphinha has been a revelation for Barça so far this season, shining in a new role as the team's No.9 after the exits of Robert Lewandowski and Ferran Torres.

He has netted 14 times in eight appearances, including back-to-back hat tricks in his last two club games.
